test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which sentence contains a correct use of the **passive voice** from the passage?

options.text: "The Author creates the meaning of the text."
"The text is furnished with a final signified."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive voice structure:** The subject of the sentence receives the action instead of performing it. The formula is: **Subject + form of 'to be' + Past Participle**.
 
• In the sentence *"The text is furnished with a final signified,"* the subject is **"The text."**
 
• The verb phrase **"is furnished"** consists of the auxiliary verb "is" (form of to be) and the past participle "furnished."
 
• The "text" is not performing the action of furnishing; it is the recipient of that action, which is the defining characteristic of the passive voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The text is furnished with a final signified."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The Author creates the meaning of the text." – This is in the **active voice** because the subject (The Author) is performing the action (creates).
 
• **Option 2:** "Language speaks the Author's intentions." – This is in the **active voice** because the subject (Language) is performing the action (speaks).
 
• **Option 3:** "Writing begins when the Author speaks." – This contains two clauses, both in the **active voice** (Writing begins; Author speaks).
